purpose.summary: This is a batch/interactive COBOL program (ORCGJ02) that is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software system. It handles accounting card input (会計カード入力) for a Japanese medical billing subsystem, managing patient insurance information, treatment records, hospitalization data, and receipt accounting workflows.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese medical insurance claims processing)

notable_features: Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in display)
SPA (Scratch Pad Area) file I/O pattern typical of ORCA screen-based programs
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for SPA data exchange
Large working storage with many flag areas (FLG-*), index areas (IDX-*), and work areas
COPY directives for shared copybooks (COMMON-SPA, J01COMMON-SPA, J02SCR-SPA, ENUM-VALUE)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based data access only
98 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprogram calls
480 PERFORM statements and 130 GOTO statements — complex procedural logic
Large file (345KB, 8296 lines) indicating production-grade complexity
Version history comments spanning 2000–2004 with multiple contributors
verdict.notes: The file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but was decoded as latin-1, resulting in garbled multi-byte characters in comments and string literals. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. The COPY statements reference external copybooks not shown here. The 'fixed' format is confirmed by max_line_length of 75 and source_format_guess. No COMP-3 usage despite being a financial/billing system is notable — numeric fields use plain PIC 9.
